history.summary: A 1,151sqft 3BR at $1.899M / $1,650 PSF near Toa Payoh (D12), trading slightly above the $1,611 URA median on a well-sampled 6.17% CAGR (53 txns). Good central-fringe location and reliable data, but it is a 28-year-old 99yr leasehold with material lease decay.
history.rating_rationale: 6.17%/yr over a robust 53-txn sample is credible and Toa Payoh's central-fringe location with NSL access supports liquidity. The decisive negative is age: a 1998 99yr leasehold has ~71yr left and decay accelerates, which is why the score_1000 sits at 461 despite the good rate. Priced just above median with no cushion, and at $1.9M it is near the top of the comfortable band. A balanced hold, not a clear buy.
red_flags: Priced above URA median, no value cushion
$1.9M sits at the upper edge of the deep buyer band
catalysts: Toa Payoh central-fringe, NSL, strong amenities and HDB-upgrader demand
